name: EPIC 201256925
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.3 solar radii and 0.99 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201256925 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.306113 (16th-84th percentiles 8.042899-8.659018), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,051 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.99 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,704 K at its surface.
